{"description":"Design: docs/design/object-history.md. Decisions: docs/design/DECISIONS.md.
Note key: H17. Crates: jmap-graph-types, jmap-graph-server. Size: M.

Scope per decision 5, confirmed by decision 22 (resolves D1). Spec: object-history-03 §3, §4, §5.1; draft-atwood-jmap-graph-00 (Graph destroy cascades to nodes and edges, node destroy to edges; an edge always connects two existing nodes); graph-edit-00 §Snapshots, §Compaction (ops die with their node); graph-provenance-00 §Retraction (history of a retracted record SHOULD be removed); graph-projection-00. Design: docs/design/object-history.md §2, §7, §9 graph bullet, and decision 22(4) in docs/design/DECISIONS.md.

Work:
- impl HistoryObject for Graph, GraphNode, GraphEdge (not GraphNodeOp, excluded by decision 22).
- _set_impl split; history handlers for all three, which all have /query.
- register_graph_handlers_with_history. register_graph_edit_handlers is unchanged.
- Memory:
  - record cascades
  - rights_changed_at per Graph
  - GraphNode blob rule (decision 6(d))
  - nodes of a projected Graph keep no history and return the live version only
  - GraphNode restore is allowed (decision 22): the node comes back at its final snapshot (blobId/snapshotSeq), its op log restarts empty with its head at snapshotSeq, and edits after the final snapshot are unrecoverable; document that in the graph-server README and on the Bk contract
  - document the provenance retraction purge on the Bk contract
- An edge restore with a destroyed endpoint ⇒ invalidProperties; it succeeds after a GraphNode/set restore earlier in the request.
- Registry cross-check test.

Acceptance:
- Cascade destroys appear in includeDestroyed.
- Edge restore: fails with the endpoint destroyed, succeeds after the node restore.
- Projected node ⇒ live version only.
- GraphNodeOp history flag ⇒ invalidArguments.
- A destroyed GraphNode edited past its last snapshot restores with its final blobId and snapshotSeq, GraphNodeOp/get or /changes shows an empty log with head at snapshotSeq, and a new op after the restore follows it (decision 22).
- CHANGELOG, public-api.","notes":"2026-11-13: updated for decision 22"}
